instructions.task: A customer of a digital bank sent this message to support chat. Which specific issue is the customer asking about? Pick the option that matches the customer's actual problem.
distinctions: If the customer says they don't recognise a transaction or didn't make it, choose the *_not_recognised option, even if they ask for a refund.
A transaction the customer made but was charged wrongly (twice, extra fee on statement, wrong rate) is not 'not recognised'.
Changing an existing PIN or a blocked PIN is different from getting a first PIN for a new card.
Fees on a payment, transfer, withdrawal or top-up are fee options; complaints that an exchange cost too much are exchange_cost_complaint.

criteria.activate_card: activating a card the customer has received
criteria.card_arrival: new/ordered card has not arrived yet, tracking card delivery
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: how long card delivery takes, delivery options
criteria.card_linking: linking/adding an existing card to the app or account
criteria.card_not_working: physical card generally not working / broken
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: virtual or disposable card not working
criteria.card_about_to_expire: card expiring, getting a replacement for an expired card
criteria.card_acceptance: where the card is accepted, whether a merchant takes it
criteria.order_physical_card: how to order/get a physical card
criteria.getting_spare_card: getting an extra/additional/spare card, card for a family member
criteria.getting_virtual_card: how to get a virtual card
criteria.disposable_virtual_card: getting a disposable virtual card, limits on disposable cards
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, choosing card brand, whether the customer's Visa or Mastercard can be used
criteria.apple_pay_google_pay: using Apple Pay / Google Pay, including topping up via Apple Pay or Google Pay
criteria.change_pin: changing or resetting an existing card PIN
criteria.pin_blocked: card PIN blocked after wrong attempts, unblocking PIN
criteria.pin_not_received: has not received a PIN yet, or how to get/set a first PIN for a new card
criteria.atm_support: where ATMs are, which ATMs accept the card, ATM not working generally (not currency or rate questions about withdrawing abroad)
criteria.declined_card_payment: card payment declined/rejected at a merchant
criteria.pending_card_payment: card payment still showing as pending
criteria.reverted_card_payment: a card payment that was reverted, cancelled or returned to the account (the cancellation already happened, e.g. payments to the card have been cancelled)
criteria.transfer_timing: how long transfers take to arrive
criteria.transfer_not_received: recipient has not received a transfer the customer sent
criteria.failed_transfer: transfer failed or couldn't be made
criteria.cancel_transfer: cancel or reverse a transfer, or a transaction not stated to be on a card; money sent to wrong account
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: cannot add a beneficiary/payee, transfer to a recipient not allowed
criteria.receiving_money: how to receive money from others, friends sending money, getting a salary paid in, including in which currency a salary can be received
criteria.transfer_into_account: how to transfer money into the account from another bank
criteria.balance_not_updated_transfer: balance not updated after an incoming bank transfer
criteria.balance_not_updated_deposit: cheque or cash deposit not showing in balance
criteria.topping_up_by_card: topping up with a card, money added by card not showing
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: topping up with cash or cheque
criteria.verify_top_up: verifying the card used for a top-up, top-up verification code
criteria.card_payment_fee: fee charged on a card payment
criteria.cash_withdrawal_fee: fee charged for ATM cash withdrawal
criteria.transfer_fee: fee charged on a transfer, including the recipient receiving less than the amount sent
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: fee for topping up by card
criteria.top_up_by_transfer_charge: fee for topping up by bank transfer
criteria.exchange_rate: what exchange rates are used for payments and exchanges, how they're set: general questions, not complaints that a rate was wrong, not rates at ATMs abroad
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: wrong exchange rate applied to a card payment, or the customer says the exchange rate they got was wrong
criteria.cash_withdrawal_wrong_exchange_rate: wrong exchange rate applied to an ATM withdrawal, or what rate/extra cost applies when withdrawing cash abroad, rates at foreign ATMs, getting cash in local or home currency from ATMs while abroad
criteria.fiat_currency_support: which currencies can be held or exchanged
criteria.supported_cards_currencies: which cards and currencies are supported for top-up/payments
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: small unexplained extra fee or charge on the statement (customer made the transaction but sees an extra amount)
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: card payment the customer doesn't recognise / didn't make, or the customer asks to cancel a transaction explicitly made on their debit/credit card
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: cash withdrawal the customer did not make at all (not a withdrawal they attempted themselves)
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: unknown direct debit the customer didn't set up
criteria.compromised_card: card details compromised, suspicious activity, card possibly used by someone else
criteria.passcode_forgotten: forgot app passcode, reset passcode, can't log into app
criteria.unknown_money_received: money appeared in the account that the customer didn't put there
criteria.request_refund: requesting a refund for a purchase, cancelling a purchase or order from a merchant, refund policy
criteria.refund_not_showing: refund from a merchant not showing up
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash: ATM gave less cash than requested
criteria.exchange_cost_complaint: complaint that a currency exchange cost too much / got a bad deal on an exchange
criteria.source_of_money_question: asking where some money in the account came from
criteria.account_security_general: general question about how the bank keeps money/account safe
criteria.reactivate_found_card: card reported lost has been found, wants to reactivate/use it again
criteria.card_fees: cost of getting a physical, extra or replacement card, express card delivery fee
criteria.age_limit: age requirements to open an account
criteria.country_support: which countries are supported, whether the account or a card is available to people living in a given country
